verdict.rationale: Morph is an API platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. The canary feature does the opposite: it routes a slice of real production traffic to a new model. Standby tier, dedicated endpoints and a community mention of a web playground are adjacent features, not a documented sandbox isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
